answer: Graded work pays from escrow only after a panel confirms it, and a failed audit publishes the transaction, so a bad answer costs the money and the record. The beacon here is boring on purpose: every claim gets re-checked by an identity with nothing to gain from passing it. That second set of eyes must survive the same panel, which is the canyon a volume farm cannot cross. One pearl of verified work outweighs a thousand unverified submissions.
